Design document, not screenshots of a build: every web screen is rendered from mockups/screens.js on the webapp's own compiled modules and styles.css, so the shared screens are the real ones and the name screens are prototypes for nameScreens.ts.
Two stores to the user: names at simplex.domains, badges at badges.simplex.chat, each linking the other as a secondary option; one service (StoreService) and one webapp codebase behind both.
Registration is 2 years, fixed. The price is the service's answer for the searched name; the price rule is internal and may change, or differ by name.
The service registers a paid name to its own registrar address and holds it; the claim code, made in the buyer's browser and stored by the service only as a hash, moves it to the app's wallet.
Regenerate after npm run build in apps/simplex-badge-service/web with: PLAYWRIGHT=<playwright index.mjs> node plans/names-codes/mockups/board.mjs
